title: AgentTaskManager runtime role
text: AgentTaskManager is the shared MCP-first Tavall harness and task runtime. Repository-owned fixes should extend the owning module and existing memory/runtime services instead of layering parallel implementations.

title: AgentTaskManager persistence responsibilities
text: Postgres owns durable relational truth, Redis owns ephemeral orchestration state, Qdrant owns semantic retrieval, and the Tavall cache layer owns TTL-aware hot and warm caching. MongoDB is the legacy artifact and chat document role and should not be treated as semantic truth.

title: Prompt thread memory flow
text: Prompt thread memory performs authoritative exact-thread lookup plus thread-scoped semantic search before MCP dispatch, merges thread memory before broader project memory, and persists accepted interactions, lookup summaries, results, failures, and compact snapshots for later recall.

title: Local semantic embedding default
text: Tavall AI semantic memory defaults to local CPU FastEmbed using BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 at 384 dimensions. Gemini and hash embeddings are explicit opt-in providers and incompatible vector spaces are isolated by collection profile.

title: Project Novus canonical repository
text: TavallStudios/tavall-project-novus main is canonical for Project Novus code, releases, tags, issues, and review. TavallMonoRepo is a private cross-project integration workspace, not an alternate source of truth. A change becomes canonical only after TavallStudios history accepts it.

title: Project Novus quality preflight
text: Every Project Novus engineering session must read every regular file under docs/quality recursively before analysis or implementation and record the quality document count and manifest SHA256 for the branch head.

title: tavall-java-tools is an aggregate
text: TavallStudios/tavall-java-tools is an aggregate repository, not an implementation origin. Implementation authority remains in the individual canonical Tavall repositories including tavall-cache, tavall-concurrency, tavall-database, tavall-di, tavall-eventbus, tavall-logging, tavall-reflection, tavall-registry, and tavall-scheduler.

title: Core Tavall organization repositories
text: Verified TavallStudios repositories include tavall-ai-agent-task-manager, tavall-project-novus, TavallMonoRepo, tavall-cloud, tavall-cache, tavall-database, tavall-registry, tavall-di, tavall-eventbus, tavall-logging, tavall-concurrency, tavall-scheduler, tavall-reflection, tavall-java-tools, HyRhythm, TavallContractors, and TavallCouriers.

title: Memory provider specialization
text: Tavall memory retrieval specializes providers by role: Postgres supplies authoritative exact state, Qdrant supplies semantic associative recall, Graphify supplies current code topology and impact, and Graphiti supplies curated temporal facts and evolving relationships. Raw Git, PR, Codex session, and runtime artifacts are evidence references fetched only when needed.

title: Do not duplicate full agent chats
text: Tavall memory should persist distilled findings, metadata, provenance, and source references rather than copying complete Codex or ChatGPT transcripts. Existing provider/session files remain the raw evidence source when verbatim history is actually required.
